reviews.author: reviewer
reviews.body: Request changes: the PR head b42f5189d890 has both poemworld CI checks still pending, so the required regression checks have not passed. In addition, workflow .forgejo/workflows/poemworld.yml invokes python -m pytest after only pip install -e ., while pytest is not declared by pyproject.toml; make the clean runner install a declared/explicit pytest dependency. Rerun the push and pull_request checks and return a head with both passing before re-requesting release review. Builder issue #6 records this actionable finding.
